content:
erin: Starting packaging window for private/vpc onprem at 04:00 UTC. Main goals: signed installer, multi-arch images, and ensure escort caches are primed.

carlos: On it. Running shrinkwrap + dedupe layers. ETA 12m.

maya: Ops note: mirrors sometimes serve stale cosign.pub leading to verify failures. We should push the pubkey and invalidate caches before first seed.

ops-jen: Agreed. Ops policy: automatic cache-invalid on first seed and an alert if >2 verify failures per lane within 5m. I'll standby on alerts.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] preparing release ref private-installer@v2024.07.07 -> staging sha256:77aa...ee11, upload s3://redwood-offline/releases/1755555555/ pending cosign.

carlos: Found a tiny metadata mismatch in the arm64 manifest entry (annotations). Rewriting manifest and retarring. +6m.

erin: If repack >10m we push the change window +30m. No forced cutover.

pkg-bot: [pkg-bot] preflight: gzip OK, manifest schema OK, arch tags: amd64,arm64.

maya: Pushing cosign pubkey to mirrors now at s3://redwood-offline/keys/cosign-2024-07.pub. Also adding a mirror-agent hook to invalidate cosign cache on first pull.

ops-jen: Hook deployed to escort lanes. Alert rule added: alert if pull_latency>100s for 3m or verify_failures>2 in 5m.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] canary schedule: lanes=[blue,green,orange], seeds=6, spacing=90s, observe=20m, pinned sha256:77aa...ee11.

carlos: Canary boot (10m): blue OK, green partial (1/2 failed verify), orange OK. Fail root cause: mirror had old cosign.pub cached.

maya: Cache invalidation pushed to green mirrors; forcing re-verify.

ops-jen: If re-verify fails twice, we'll evict that seed and re-seed after confirming pubkey propagation.

pkg-bot: (18m) green recovered after invalidation. All seeds verified. Bandwidth and pull latency nominal.

erin: Proceed to rolling batches in 8m. Rolling plan: batches of 5 nodes, 12m between batches, inter-batch pause 4m for metrics.

carlos: Quick rollback snippet added to runbook:
```
deploy-bot rollback --target private-installer --pin v2024.06.25
opsctl escort evict --selector release=canary
```

maya: Post-roll action: add a packaging CI step to publish cosign pubkey and trigger mirror-agent invalidation. Filing ticket PCK-1247.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] rolling batches started: batch_size=5 pause_between=12m.

pkg-bot: (end) Rolling complete. No post-rollout evictions. Artifact TTL set to 90d. KMS audit logged: KMS-2024-07-07-01.

ops-jen: Adding a telemetry metric cosign.cache.miss.count and an alert on sudden spikes.

erin: Thanks team. Closing thread unless anyone sees issues.

carlos: Final note: bumped manifest ordering to deterministic mode to avoid transport reordering in high-latency lanes. Documenting in release notes.

maya: Pubkey pushed to mirrors and installer fallback will query KMS for key on first boot.

erin: Great. :rocket:
